senses.gloss: (b. h.) to press, squeeze, crush. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 נכנסו … ורָצְצוּ וכ׳ the rocks were moved into the caves and crushed all those warriors; Num. R. s. 19.
units: Cant. R. to I, 6 (play on רִצְפָּה, Is. VI, 6) רוֹץ פֶּה רְצוֹץ פה וכ׳ ritspah means rots peh, crush the mouth of him (Isaiah) who spoke ill of my children; Tanḥ. Vayishl. 2; Pesik. R. s. 33 רֹץ פה; Yalk. Num. 764; Yalk. Is. 273 רַצֵּץ (Pi.); Yalk. Kings 218 רצץ. Cant. R. l. c. (play on רְצָפִים I Kings XIX, 6) [read:] רץ פים רצוץ פיות וכ׳ crush the mouths of all who (like Elijah) speak ill of my children.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:1:8">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שלא יָרוֹץ את וכ׳</he> lest he (the gentile) break his (the Jew’s) skull. Y. Macc. II, beg. 31ᶜ <he>והושיט … ורְצָצָהּ</he> and a child put forth his hand (under the roller), and he crushed it.
Bets. 34ᵃ רְצָצַתָּהּ בהמה a beast squeezed it (an animal, against a wall); Ḥull. III, 3 (56ᵃ) Ms. M. (ed. רִיצְּצַתָּהּ, Pi.).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30<sup>17</sup></cite> <he>רָצְצוּ גפנים</he> they crushed the vines; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:22">Gen. XXV, 22</cite>) <he>שזה רַץ להרוג וכ׳</he> this one pressed to kill that one &c.
<cite ref="Genesis 25:22">Ib.</cite> <he>עשו רץ ומפרכס וכ׳</he> Esau pressed and struggled to get out.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T01000">same</cite>. Ḥull. l. c., v. supra. Y. Kidd. IV, end, 66ᶜ <he>הטוב … רַצֵּץ את מוחו</he> the best of the serpents—crush its brain. Yalk. Kings l. c.; Yalk. Is. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 137:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII</cite>; Yalk. ib. 884 they put their thumbs into their mouths <he>ומְרַצְּצִים אותם</he> and crushed them (with their teeth); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>ומרצצים ומקצצים אותם</he> crushed and bit them off; a. e.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 58:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LVIII</cite> (ref. to <he>ויתרצצו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 25:22">Gen. XXV, 22</cite>) <he>שהיה מְרַצֵּץ עם וכ׳</he> he (Esau) struggled with his brother in his mother’s womb.

senses.gloss: to crush. Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ bot. הרי אתם … בשביל שיָרֵיצּוּ את מוחי you place my head between two high mountains …, that they may crush my brain (you want me to decide between two great authorities); Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 18.
to press, rush in a crowd. Tanḥ. Balak 4; Num. R. s. 20 like the money-changer שהכל מְרִיצִּים לו to whom all rush (to have their coins examined).
, Nithpol. נִתְרוֹצֵץ to press one another, struggle. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 15 כיון שנתְרוֹצְצוּ וכ׳ when the children struggled together within her.
